page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 62.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage solutions. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between CPU-only tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. Single-core CPU performance is positioned in the bottom 25% according to stress-ng and Geekbench tests, while multi-core performance falls into the middle 50% tier. However, the integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong performance in machine learning tasks. LLM inference prompt processing for both small (135M) and medium (7B) models ranks in the top 10%, and text generation for a 7B model is in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth and database operations consistently perform within average ranges.

Given its hardware profile, this instance offers a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads that do not require massive parallel compute arrays. The lack of local storage and moderate network bandwidth are trade-offs to consider for data-intensive pipelines. It is highly suited for low-to-medium scale deep learning inference, small-to-medium LLM serving, video transcoding, and general-purpose GPU computing where dedicated CPU cores and moderate memory capacity are required.
